items.review_rationale: Read normed vector space as pair of vector space over normed division ring and a specified norm function, preserving structure rather than existential normability.

references.phrase: norm with division ring scalar norm

references.context: Structure (V,∥·∥) consists of one specified norm on vector space V, rather than merely existence of a norm.

items.review_rationale: Read positive-definite symmetric bilinear real inner product on real vector space with no complex conjugation.

references.context: Bilinear form V×V→R linear in both arguments and symmetric on interchange of arguments.
For nonzero v, the real self-pairing is positive, and vanishes for the zero vector.

references.phrase: real rather than complex Hermitian convention
references.disposition: No conjugate-linear component in the real bilinear form definition.
